full_judgment:
This Rule seeks to call in question the legality and propriety of the judgment and decree dated 21.6.82 passed by the learned Subordinate Judge, Additional Court, Rajshahi in Title Appeal No. 58 of 1981 affirming those dated 23.3.81 passed by the learned Munsif, Natore in O.C. Suit No. 311 of 1976. 

 4. On these pleadings both the parties adduced evidence in support of their respective contentions. On consideration of evidence the trial Court held that impugned deed is tainted with fraud and that plaintiff opposite party did not get independent and disinterested advice prior to the execution and registration of the deed in question and on that finding he held the impugned deed to be invalid and inoperative and not binding against opposite party and passed the decree. Being aggrieved by the decision defendant-petitioner preferred appeal before the District Judge, Rajshahi and the appeal was heard by the learned Subordinate Judge, Additional Court, Rajshahi. He also framed several issues including issue on the point of maintainability and on consideration of the evidence on record independently, concurred with decision of the trial Court and dismissed the appeal. Now being dis- satisfied with the decision of the appellate Court defendant petitioner moved the Provisional Jurisdiction .of this Court by filing an application under section 115(1) of the Code of Civil Procedure and obtained the present Rule. 

 14. In the result, the Rule is made absolute without any order as to costs. The judgment and decree of both the Courts below are set aside and the suit sent back on remand to the trial Court for holding trial in the light of observation made above. Par- ties are given liberty to have their pleadings amended but no fresh evidence will be admitted. Cost will abide by the result of the suit.
